quality_review.method: Agent manually compared every one of 305 validated public synthetic paraphrases with its seed. 202 stratified initial, 103 remainder. Conservative per-item/family rejection before training. Generic emoji removal is formatting only.
seed_repairs: RETURN:1 closing active loan rather than ambiguous finish checkout
FIELD:2 explicitly compare metadata instead of physical placement
wrong_examples: RETURN:4 changed end borrowing period into extension
AVAILABILITY:0 changed current copy status into future arrangement
LOANS:0 changed my borrowed books into books with you
quality_review.post_filter_review: Every retained paraphrase inspected. No remaining detected semantic drift; reviewer judgement, not external annotation or statistical guarantee.
